about.heading: About Us
about.body1: "Our Kanchana" is a non-political, voluntary, public-welfare social platform formed by students, youth, professionals, social workers and conscious citizens of Kanchana.
about.body2: We work to raise awareness among the people of Kanchana, keep young people away from drugs and gambling by engaging them in positive activities, and identify and take initiative to solve local problems.
about.body3: We believe sustainable development of society is not possible through infrastructure alone; it requires conscious citizens, a responsible young generation, social unity, volunteerism and the active participation of the people.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: To build a beautiful, safe, drug-free, humane, conscious and prosperous Kanchana through the participation of its people.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: To take effective initiatives for the welfare of the people of Kanchana through social unity, volunteerism, youth leadership and public engagement.
